svg.text: general-restart.yaml, Solve: retried while it exits non-zero (max-retries = max_restarts, timeout = attempt_timeout)
one attempt = general.yaml, whole, on the shared case directory with restart.resume and restart.attempt on
preprocessing reruns every attempt (checkout, environment, params.in, case.sh), then script_submitter runs case.sh
case.sh forwards the walltime SIGTERM to simulator.sh, which (restart.sh):
skips blockMesh, decomposePar and potentialFoam once done · discards a checkpoint cut short · restarts from latestTime
writes a checkpoint every checkpoint_every iterations · logs the attempt · tells a signal from a solver's own failure
results, Read the Coefficients (app/read-results.sh), is the loop control:
solved → exit 0 (over)
failed on its own → exit 0 (over, final: attempt on)
interrupted → exit 1 (the retry resumes it)
what interrupts an attempt
the scheduler's walltime (cluster.slurm.time)
the attempt budget (restart.attempt_timeout)
a preempted or lost node (no record left)
the case directory, shared by every attempt
attempts.log: a start and an end line per attempt
case/restart/inputs: the design and settings
case/restart/<stage>.done: what is finished
case/restart/failed: a solver that failed on its own
case/<iteration>/: the checkpoints kept
case/log.simpleFoam.<n>: the solver log of attempt n
results.out, exit_code: the case's outcome files
a later run given this directory continues it
Report (if: always)
reads attempts.log and the state files:
solved in N attempts, K interrupted
→ Cd, Cl, the run completes
failed on its own (diverged) → error,
never retried
attempts ran out, still interrupted
→ error, the case stays resumable
